title: 遺失物品
description: 物品遺失時的處理用語

sentences.en: I believe I left my passport, which contains my visa and all my identification, somewhere in the taxi I took from the airport.
sentences.zh: 我相信我把護照忘在從機場搭的計程車上了，裡面有我的簽證和所有身分證件。

sentences.en: Could you please check the lost and found department to see if anyone has turned in a black leather wallet containing several credit cards?
sentences.zh: 能否請你幫我查一下失物招領處，看看有沒有人交回一個裝有幾張信用卡的黑色皮夾？

sentences.en: The bag that I lost at the train station this morning had my laptop, charger, and several important documents inside it.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上在火車站丟失的包包裡面有我的筆電、充電器和幾份重要文件。

sentences.en: I would like to file a report for my missing suitcase, which was supposed to arrive on the same flight but never appeared on the carousel.
sentences.zh: 我想申報我遺失的行李箱，它應該搭同一班飛機到達，但從未出現在行李轉盤上。

sentences.en: My phone, which I had been using to navigate just moments before, seems to have fallen out of my pocket while I was sitting on the bench.
sentences.zh: 我的手機剛才還在用來導航，似乎在我坐在長椅上時從口袋裡掉了出來。

sentences.en: Is there any way to track my luggage, which has a distinctive red ribbon tied to the handle, through the airline's tracking system?
sentences.zh: 有沒有辦法通過航空公司的追蹤系統找到我的行李？把手上綁了一條很醒目的紅色緞帶。

sentences.en: I accidentally left my camera, an expensive professional model that I use for work, on the table at the restaurant where we had lunch.
sentences.zh: 我不小心把相機忘在我們吃午餐的餐廳桌上了，那是一台我工作用的昂貴專業相機。

sentences.en: The jacket I lost has my hotel room key and a significant amount of cash in the inside pocket, which is why I am so worried.
sentences.zh: 我弄丟的外套內口袋裡有旅館房間鑰匙和一大筆現金，所以我非常擔心。

sentences.en: I need to cancel my credit cards immediately because my wallet, which contained all of them, was either lost or stolen at the market.
sentences.zh: 我需要立即取消信用卡，因為裝著所有卡的皮夾在市場不是弄丟了就是被偷了。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to review the security camera footage from this afternoon to help me locate my missing backpack?
sentences.zh: 是否有可能調閱今天下午的監視器畫面，幫我找到我遺失的背包？

sentences.en: The last time I remember having my keys was when I placed them on the counter at the coffee shop near the central station.
sentences.zh: 我最後記得有鑰匙是我把它們放在中央車站附近咖啡店櫃台上的時候。

sentences.en: I am looking for a small blue pouch containing my prescription glasses, which I desperately need in order to read and navigate.
sentences.zh: 我在找一個裝著處方眼鏡的藍色小袋子，我非常需要它來閱讀和認路。

sentences.en: Someone at the front desk told me that items left on the tour bus are usually collected by the driver and returned the following day.
sentences.zh: 櫃台的人告訴我，遺留在旅遊巴士上的物品通常由司機收集，隔天歸還。

sentences.en: My child lost his favorite stuffed animal, which is a small brown bear wearing a red scarf, somewhere in the amusement park today.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子今天在遊樂園裡某處弄丟了他最喜歡的填充玩偶，是一隻戴紅圍巾的棕色小熊。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could keep an eye out for a silver ring with a blue stone that I may have dropped near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 如果你能幫我留意一下一枚鑲藍色寶石的銀戒指，我會很感激，我可能在入口附近掉的。

sentences.en: The umbrella I left behind, which belongs to a colleague who lent it to me this morning, has a wooden handle with her initials carved on it.
sentences.zh: 我忘掉的那把傘是同事今早借我的，木頭把手上刻著她的姓名縮寫。

sentences.en: After searching the entire hotel room thoroughly, I am now certain that my jewelry must have been left at the spa I visited earlier today.
sentences.zh: 徹底搜遍整個旅館房間後，我現在確定我的珠寶一定是忘在今天稍早去的水療中心了。

sentences.en: I need to report a lost item to the police because my bag contained not only money but also my only form of identification.
sentences.zh: 我需要向警察報失，因為我的包包裡不只有錢，還有我唯一的身分證件。

sentences.en: The airline representative informed me that my delayed luggage, which had been mistakenly sent to another city, would be delivered to my hotel tonight.
sentences.zh: 航空公司代表通知我，被誤送到另一個城市的延誤行李今晚會送到我的旅館。

sentences.en: Could you help me write a description of the items I lost so that I can submit it to the lost and found office in this building?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我寫一份遺失物品的描述嗎？這樣我可以提交給這棟大樓的失物招領處。

sentences.en: I think someone may have accidentally picked up my suitcase, which looks identical to many others, from the baggage claim area.
sentences.zh: 我想可能有人在行李領取區不小心拿了我的行李箱，因為它看起來和很多其他的一模一樣。

sentences.en: My passport was inside the document holder that I placed on the counter when I was checking in, and I forgot to pick it up afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我的護照在我辦理入住時放在櫃台上的文件夾裡，之後忘了拿回來。

sentences.en: I realized that my tablet, which I had been using to read during the flight, is no longer in my carry-on bag or the seat pocket.
sentences.zh: 我發現我在飛機上用來閱讀的平板電腦不在隨身行李或座位口袋裡了。

sentences.en: The purse that was stolen from me contained my house keys, driver's license, and a flash drive with irreplaceable family photographs.
sentences.zh: 被偷走的手提包裡有我的房屋鑰匙、駕照，和一個存有無可替代的家庭照片的隨身碟。

sentences.en: Would you be able to make an announcement over the loudspeaker asking if anyone has found a pair of glasses in a brown case?
sentences.zh: 你能不能用廣播問一下有沒有人撿到一副裝在棕色眼鏡盒裡的眼鏡？

sentences.en: I left my shopping bags, which contained gifts for my entire family, at the food court on the third floor of the shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 我把購物袋忘在商場三樓的美食街了，裡面裝著要給全家人的禮物。

sentences.en: Since I lost my phone and cannot access my boarding pass, I need to find another way to check in for my departing flight tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 因為手機丟了無法取得登機證，我需要找其他方式辦理明天出發航班的報到。

sentences.en: The hotel staff kindly offered to contact the restaurant where I had dinner to ask whether my forgotten scarf had been found by anyone.
sentences.zh: 旅館工作人員好心地提議聯繫我晚餐的餐廳，詢問是否有人找到我忘記的圍巾。

sentences.en: I am quite distressed because the notebook I lost contains handwritten research notes that took me several months to compile.
sentences.zh: 我非常沮喪，因為我弄丟的筆記本裡有花了好幾個月整理的手寫研究筆記。

sentences.en: If anyone finds a set of car keys attached to a small leather keychain with a compass, please bring them to the information desk.
sentences.zh: 如果有人找到一串附有小皮革鑰匙圈和指南針的車鑰匙，請送到服務台。
